entries.title: II Samuel 22:1
segments: ¶And David spake unto the LORD the words of this song in the day [that] the LORD had delivered him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul:

entries.title: II Samuel 22:2
segments: ¶And he said, The LORD [is] my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer;

entries.title: II Samuel 22:3
segments: The God of my rock; in him will I trust: [he is] my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my refuge, my saviour; thou savest me from violence.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:4
segments: I will call on the LORD, [who is] worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:5
segments: When the waves of death compassed me, the floods of ungodly men made me afraid; {waves: or, pangs} {ungodly...: Heb. Belial}

entries.title: II Samuel 22:6
segments: The sorrows of hell compassed me about; the snares of death prevented me; {sorrows: or, cords}

entries.title: II Samuel 22:7
segments: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried to my God: and he did hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry [did enter] into his ears.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:8
segments: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations of heaven moved and shook, because he was wroth.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:9
segments: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it. {out of his nostrils: Heb. by, etc}

words.text: by it. {out of his nostrils: Heb. by, etc}

entries.title: II Samuel 22:10
segments: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and darkness [was] under his feet.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:11
segments: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: and he was seen upon the wings of the wind.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:12
segments: And he made darkness pavilions round about him, dark waters, [and] thick clouds of the skies. {dark...: Heb. binding of waters}

entries.title: II Samuel 22:13
segments: Through the brightness before him were coals of fire kindled.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:14
segments: The LORD thundered from heaven, and the most High uttered his voice.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:15
segments: And he sent out arrows, and scattered them; lightning, and discomfited them.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:16
segments: And the channels of the sea appeared, the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuking of the LORD, at the blast of the breath of his nostrils.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:17
segments: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters; {many: or, great}

entries.title: II Samuel 22:18
segments: He delivered me from my strong enemy, [and] from them that hated me: for they were too strong for me.

words.text: me: for they were too strong

entries.title: II Samuel 22:19
segments: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the LORD was my stay.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:20
segments: He brought me forth also into a large place: he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:21
segments: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness: according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:22
segments: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:23
segments: For all his judgments [were] before me: and [as for] his statutes, I did not depart from them.

words.text: [were] before me: and [as for] his statutes

entries.title: II Samuel 22:24
segments: I was also upright before him, and have kept myself from mine iniquity. {before: Heb. to}

entries.title: II Samuel 22:25
segments: Therefore the LORD hath recompensed me according to my righteousness; according to my cleanness in his eye sight. {in...: Heb. before his eyes}

entries.title: II Samuel 22:26
segments: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful, [and] with the upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:27
segments: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself unsavoury. {shew thyself unsavoury: or, wrestle}

entries.title: II Samuel 22:28
segments: And the afflicted people thou wilt save: but thine eyes [are] upon the haughty, [that] thou mayest bring [them] down.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:29
segments: For thou [art] my lamp, O LORD: and the LORD will lighten my darkness. {lamp: or, candle}

entries.title: II Samuel 22:30
segments: For by thee I have run through a troop: by my God have I leaped over a wall. {run: or, broken}

words.text: For by thee I have run

entries.title: II Samuel 22:31
segments: [As for] God, his way [is] perfect; the word of the LORD [is] tried: he [is] a buckler to all them that trust in him. {tried: or, refined}

entries.title: II Samuel 22:32
segments: For who [is] God, save the LORD? and who [is] a rock, save our God?

entries.title: II Samuel 22:33
segments: God [is] my strength [and] power: and he maketh my way perfect. {maketh: Heb. riddeth, or, looseth}

entries.title: II Samuel 22:34
segments: He maketh my feet like hinds' [feet]: and setteth me upon my high places. {maketh: Heb. equalleth}

entries.title: II Samuel 22:35
segments: He teacheth my hands to war; so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms. {to war: Heb. for the war}

entries.title: II Samuel 22:36
segments: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy gentleness hath made me great. {made...: Heb. multiplied me}

entries.title: II Samuel 22:37
segments: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; so that my feet did not slip. {feet: Heb. ankles}

words.text: under me; so that my feet

entries.title: II Samuel 22:38
segments: I have pursued mine enemies, and destroyed them; and turned not again until I had consumed them.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:39
segments: And I have consumed them, and wounded them, that they could not arise: yea, they are fallen under my feet.

words.text: them, that they could not arise

entries.title: II Samuel 22:40
segments: For thou hast girded me with strength to battle: them that rose up against me hast thou subdued under me. {subdued: Heb. caused to bow}

words.text: under me. {subdued: Heb. caused to bow}

entries.title: II Samuel 22:41
segments: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies, that I might destroy them that hate me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:42
segments: They looked, but [there was] none to save; [even] unto the LORD, but he answered them not.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:43
segments: Then did I beat them as small as the dust of the earth, I did stamp them as the mire of the street, [and] did spread them abroad.

words.text: them as small as the dust

entries.title: II Samuel 22:44
segments: Thou also hast delivered me from the strivings of my people, thou hast kept me [to be] head of the heathen: a people [which] I knew not shall serve me.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:45
segments: Strangers shall submit themselves unto me: as soon as they hear, they shall be obedient unto me. {Strangers: Heb. Sons of the stranger} {submit...: or, yield feigned obedience: Heb. lie}

words.text: themselves unto me: as soon as they hear
unto me. {Strangers: Heb. Sons of the stranger} {submit...: or, yield feigned obedience: Heb. lie}

entries.title: II Samuel 22:46
segments: Strangers shall fade away, and they shall be afraid out of their close places.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:47
segments: The LORD liveth; and blessed [be] my rock; and exalted be the God of the rock of my salvation.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:48
segments: It [is] God that avengeth me, and that bringeth down the people under me, {avengeth: Heb. giveth avengement for}

words.text: under me, {avengeth: Heb. giveth avengement for}

entries.title: II Samuel 22:49
segments: And that bringeth me forth from mine enemies: thou also hast lifted me up on high above them that rose up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

words.text: : thou also hast lifted me up on high

entries.title: II Samuel 22:50
segments: Therefore I will give thanks unto thee, O LORD, among the heathen, and I will sing praises unto thy name.

entries.title: II Samuel 22:51
segments: [He is] the tower of salvation for his king: and sheweth mercy to his anointed, unto David, and to his seed for evermore.
